name: BLS Polymers
summary: BLS Polymers, incorporated in 2003, makes custom polymer compounds (HDPE, MDPE, LLDPE, XLPE, HFFR, PVC and adhesive coatings) for wire and cable insulation and 3LPE pipeline coating, from a single plant in Goa; wires and cables make up about 81% of sales. Revenue grew slowly, from ₹296 cr in FY24 to ₹349 cr in FY26 (about 8.6% a year), but profit rose from ₹7.5 cr to ₹27.0 cr as the net margin widened to 7.7% and debt to equity fell to 0.54. The whole ₹255 cr issue is fresh money, with ₹77.6 cr for expanding the Goa plant and ₹89.5 cr for working capital. At the upper band the post-issue P/E is about 34.5x, well above the 14.5x median of the listed peers named in the RHP, and the top customer alone gave 31.7% of FY26 revenue.

checks.name: Revenue growth
checks.finding: Revenue rose from ₹296.4 cr (FY24) to ₹349.4 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about 8.6%.

checks.name: Revenue rose every year
checks.finding: Revenue grew every year: ₹296 cr, ₹328 cr, ₹349 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Debt to equity
checks.finding: Debt to equity was 0.54 in FY26 (borrowings ₹51.7 cr vs net worth ₹94.9 cr).

checks.name: Debt growing slower than revenue
checks.finding: Borrowings fell from ₹93.8 cr to ₹51.7 cr over FY24–FY26 while total income rose 18%.

checks.name: Net worth rising
checks.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹46.8 cr, ₹67.9 cr, ₹94.9 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Positive operating cash flow
checks.finding: Operating cash flow was ₹38.1 cr in FY26, above the ₹27.0 cr profit; it turned negative (₹-6.6 cr) in Q1 FY27.

checks.name: Profit growth
checks.finding: Profit after tax grew about 28% in FY26, to ₹27.0 cr from ₹21.1 cr.

checks.name: Profit margin trend
checks.finding: Net margin improved from 2.49% (FY24) to 6.28% (FY25) and 7.62% (FY26).

checks.name: Return on equity
checks.finding: ROE was 33.2% in FY26 (RoNW 28.5%).

checks.name: Return on capital employed
checks.finding: ROCE was 29.5% in FY26, up from 25.5% in FY25.

checks.name: Margin vs listed peers
checks.finding: Peer margins were not found in public sources.

checks.name: P/E vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue P/E of about 34.5x vs a peer median of 14.5x (Ddev Plastiks 13.0x, Plastiblends 14.5x, Kingfa Science 46.3x).

checks.name: Price to book vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue price to book of about 2.66x (₹930 cr market cap vs about ₹350 cr post-issue net worth) vs a peer median of 1.95x.

checks.name: Market cap to sales vs listed peers
checks.finding: Peer market cap to sales figures were not found in public sources.

checks.name: Recent pre-IPO share price
checks.finding: No priced share issues or transfers in the 12 months before the IPO were found; the only reported event is a 369:100 bonus issue in May 2025.

checks.name: Promoter holding after the issue
checks.finding: Promoters hold 71.53% after the issue, down from 98.53%.

checks.name: No pledged promoter shares
checks.finding: No information on pledged promoter shares was found.

checks.name: Related-party transactions
checks.finding: Related-party transaction figures were not found in public sources.

checks.name: No regulatory action against promoters
checks.finding: No information on regulatory action against promoters was found.

checks.name: Offer for sale share of the issue
checks.finding: The entire ₹255 cr issue is fresh; there is no offer for sale.

checks.name: Free float after listing
checks.finding: The issue is about 27.4% of the ₹930 cr post-issue market cap.

checks.name: Selling shareholders' cost
checks.finding: No selling shareholders, because there is no offer for sale.

checks.name: Money for growth
checks.finding: ₹77.56 cr, or 30.4% of the issue, funds capacity expansion at the Goa plant.

checks.name: Debt repayment share
checks.finding: None of the proceeds go to repaying debt; ₹89.5 cr goes to working capital.

checks.name: General corporate purposes
checks.finding: General corporate purposes plus issue expenses take the remaining ₹87.94 cr (34.5%); the split between the two is not published.

checks.name: No repayment to promoter entities
checks.finding: No proceeds are used to repay loans, so none go to promoter entities.

checks.name: Litigation against the company
checks.finding: Litigation amounts were not found in public sources.

checks.name: Criminal or regulatory cases
checks.finding: Past corporate-law lapses with pending regularisation applications that could lead to penalties are noted as a risk.

checks.name: Contingent liabilities
checks.finding: Contingent liabilities were ₹14.15 cr at June 2026, about 15% of FY26 net worth of ₹94.9 cr.

checks.name: Customer concentration
checks.finding: The top customer gave 31.74% and the top 10 customers 66.81% of FY26 revenue.

checks.name: Supplier dependence
checks.finding: Supplier concentration and the lack of long-term raw material contracts are called out as risks; exact shares are not published.

checks.name: Operating history
checks.finding: Incorporated in 2003, so about 23 years of operating history.

checks.name: Auditor remarks
checks.finding: Auditor remarks were not found in public sources.
